purpose: Annotation work-orders for every unlabeled fresh evaluation clip. NO labels are created here — this pack only enumerates what a future (post-freeze, label-blind-lifted or dev-eligible) annotation pass must produce so fresh-generalization accuracy can be measured with real denominators.

policy.labelBlindHoldout: The 12 fresh_candidate clips are label-blind (registry labelBlind: true). Per the fresh-pool policy (docs/HANDOFF_V4_DRAFT.md, wave-e e08 precedent), no target/event/stroke/contact labels may be created for them until an approved evaluation freeze designates them as the measurement set. This pack prepares the work, it does not perform it.
policy.devPool: The 3 dev_label_eligible clips may be labeled now via the normal append-only annotation front door (ml/annotations guide v1), but as dev material their labels are development evidence, not fresh-generalization proof.
policy.tier: All labels produced from this pack must be human labels (Tier-A/B per repo tiering). Machine labels are Tier-C and never Gold.

annotationTasksPerClip: target player identity spans (who is the analyzed player, with contested/crossing intervals marked)
stroke events: startMs/endMs/peak, stroke family + technique slug per taxonomy (packages/shared-types/src/pickleballTaxonomy.ts)
contact times (contactMs) per stroke event, or explicit no-contact
condition checklist per clip: doubles, crossing_players, adjacent_courts, occlusion, near_far_position, edge_on_paddle, motion_blur
capture notes: camera angle, distance, lighting, overlay/graphics
